open_questions: Only routes on the same pair (either direction) get lanes. Routes that merely run along a shared corridor between different pairs are not separated: wanted?
Two neighbouring lanes' tags can sit about 20 px apart; tags are not collision-avoided.
handoff: map.set_routes gives each route on one unordered pair a lane slot (_lane_of: centred on 0, signed to the route's own left, 0 for a lone route). route_line.setup(..., lane) shifts p0, control point and p2 sideways by slot x 0.45 x planet radius after the sun waypoint is solved, so sun clearance and tags follow. Line is rebuilt when the slot changes. Route tags: Label3D kept as a transparent position/text carrier; a 2D Label (tag2d) sits on the map label layer above the blur, placed in _place_route_tags. Tests added (different curves, lone unchanged, slots); run.sh 1874 pass 0 fail. Screenshot qa/reports/route_lanes.png (qa/bots/route_lanes_shot.gd) shows three lines on Voltara-Tillam apart. Checked by eye in that shot only; other zoom levels and views not checked.
